name: Cammeray: the Warringah Fwy's bridges over Brook St, and the on-ramp beside it

move.why: The Warringah Fwy's southbound bridge over Brook St ends 11 m from Brook St's middle in OSM, so the motorway on the ground after it reached 0.6 m into Brook St's carriageway, 5-6 m higher (check-layers: ground 5.7 m over Brook St at (-1024, -5710)). Its end moved 6 m on along its line: the bridge is 39 m long, clear of Brook St and the wall beside it
The Warringah Fwy's northbound bridge over Brook St, as the southbound's: its start moved 6 m back along its line, clear of Brook St (check-layers: ground 5.9 m over Brook St at (-1028, -5685))

The Brook St on-ramp where it leaves Brook St south of the bridges: OSM draws its carriageway a metre into Brook St's. With the bridges longer (above), Brook St's cutting under them is 0.5 m shallower and the ramp no longer sinks with it: it parts from Brook St 1.6 m higher, and in the trial build a car on its edge stopped dead at (-1017, -5756). Moved east up to 2.5 m, onto the island between them in NSW's aerial
